messages:
isabel: Heads-up from onboarding: our CI failed because SDK and REST disagree on /admin/backup. REST POST /admin/backup?level=full returns 202, but Node SDK client.admin.backup({level:'full'}) errors 404.
noah: which SDK version?
isabel: node v1.17.0 in sample-app-onboard. curl works fine.
dena: 404 means the method isn't wired in the SDK router. We intentionally exposed a small admin surface, looks like backup wasn't included.
isabel: minimal repro: REST that works:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/backup?level=full"
```
Node SDK that 404s:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({token: process.env.T});
await client.admin.backup({level: 'full'}); // 404
```
noah: ok we should add admin.backup to the SDK. But also noticed a separate parity bug: SDK query param serializer coerces numbers and booleans to strings for nested query objects. In this case ?retention_days=7 gets sent as "7" and backend strict-JSON parsing rejects it intermittently.
dena: Where is that conversion happening? SDK helper or sample-cli?
isabel: Both — sample-cli wraps flags and does JSON.stringify on values before passing to SDK, then SDK stringify again. Double-stringification.
noah: That explains some flaky CI behavior. Also another serious issue: SDK retry policy is replaying POST /admin/backup when server returns 409 (concurrent backup in flight), leading to duplicate backup jobs. REST guidance is 409 should surface to caller so they can inspect and not blindly retry.
dena: Oof. So three problems: (A) missing admin.backup method in node SDK, (B) param type coercion/stringify in CLI+SDK, (C) retry policy replaying non-idempotent POSTs on 409.
isabel: Workaround for now: call REST directly from CI (curl) and add a guard to avoid starting backup if a recent one exists.
cli-bot: Quick note: temporary workaround script: check /admin/backup/status first, and pass explicit header Idempotency-Key for POST if using SDK.
noah: Proposed fixes: 1) Add admin.backup passthrough in node SDK + unit test. 2) Change query serializer to preserve primitive types (numbers/booleans) and add validation in sample-cli to avoid pre-stringifying values. 3) Update SDK retry table: do not treat 409 as retryable for POST; only auto-retry idempotent methods or when Idempotency-Key is present.
dena: I'll draft PRs: one for router mapping, one for serializer, and one small change to the retrier config. I'll include e2e tests that hit a mocked admin endpoint to verify parity.
isabel: Please also add a lint to sample-cli that fails if env flags are stringified. That prevented us from catching the issue earlier.
dena: Good call. I'll add a rule and a test in the sample-app suite.
noah: I'll review the retrier semantics for backups specifically — backups should probably return a friendly error if concurrent. We might also add a server response that suggests a Retry-After if retry is safe.
isabel: Thanks. Tagging @devops for visibility — onboarding is blocked until we have a patch or CI workaround.
deploy-bot: PR opened: sdk/node#478 "admin-backup-passthrough + serializer tests" — CI started. :rocket:
